name: Tempoblade
summary:
STEP INTO THE NEON GRID. FEEL THE BEAT. DESTROY THE BOSS.

TempoBlade is a high-octane VR rhythm-action game that combines precision sword slasher gameplay with epic boss battles set in a 100% Retro Synthwave universe.

Equip your dual energy blades, slice through waves of incoming crystal shards synced to pulsating electronica, and face off against colossal cyber bosses waiting at the end of the track!

⚔️ KEY FEATURES
